meta_title: Manicure, pedicure and technical pedicure in Palma | VA Beauty Studio
meta_description: Beauty salon in Ponent, Palma de Mallorca: manicure, pedicure, technical pedicure, nails and facials. 5 languages spoken. Book online or on WhatsApp.
about_text: VA Beauty Studio is a beauty salon in the Ponent district of Palma de Mallorca, at Carrer Albó 2. We offer manicures and pedicures with gel polish or gel, pain-free technical pedicure (for men too), nail extensions and facial treatments such as Hydrofacial, microneedling and peels. We work with sterilised instruments and quality products, and we speak English, Spanish, German, Ukrainian and Russian. Book online or on WhatsApp, and we'll confirm your day and time personally.
